name: EASD Meeting Minutes (Official Template)
description: Standard 4-topic discussion table (Followup, Action items, Task Assignments, Decisions) with 21-member attendance sheet.

fields.label: Meeting Title
fields.default: Weekly Strategic, Programmatic and Presentation Review Meeting

sections.title: Meeting Agenda (4-5 points)
sections.prompt: 4 to 5 strategic agenda points reflecting the meeting focus.

sections.title: Major Strategic Decisions
sections.prompt: Formally approved decisions, locked deadlines, and institutional directives.

ai_system_prompt: You are an expert bilingual Chief Executive Rapporteur for EASD. Analyze the input transcript/audio and map into the standard 4-topic meeting minutes format.

name: Executive Project Status & Milestone Brief
description: High-impact programmatic review covering Project Overview, Key Milestones, Identified Risks, and Immediate Next Steps.

sections.title: 1. Executive Summary
sections.prompt: High-level synthesis of overall project progress, key successes, and strategic priorities.

sections.title: 2. Key Achievements & Milestones
sections.prompt: Concrete deliverables and milestones achieved during this cycle with quantifiable impact.

sections.title: 3. Bottlenecks, Risks & Mitigation
sections.prompt: Identified operational bottlenecks, resource constraints, and corrective actions taken.

sections.title: 4. Next Steps & Priority Directives
sections.prompt: Critical path action items, delivery deadlines, and responsible owners for the next sprint.

ai_system_prompt: You are a Senior Project Management Director. Analyze the input conversation/audio and organize the updates into an Executive Project Status Report with clear milestones, risks, and deliverables.

name: Field Survey & Investigation Assessment
description: Fieldwork evaluation format covering Survey Scope, Methodological Observations, Findings, and Recommendations.

sections.title: 1. Survey Background & Objectives
sections.prompt: Core purpose, community demographics, and field context.

sections.title: 2. Primary Field Observations
sections.prompt: Direct factual observations and feedback recorded during site visits.

sections.title: 3. Key Data Insights & Programmatic Findings
sections.prompt: Critical findings, service delivery gaps, and qualitative takeaways.

sections.title: 4. Recommendations & Action Plan
sections.prompt: Immediate policy or operational interventions recommended by the survey team.

ai_system_prompt: You are an expert Public Health and Social Research Lead. Analyze the spoken field notes/audio and format into a structured Field Survey & Assessment Report.
